reasons: The selector uses otel_metric_type="gauge", but nginx.requests is defined as a monotonic sum and the dataset only has dataset_types [sum]. The selector matches no series, so the candidate does not return the Datadog series.
Fix the matcher to otel_metric_type="sum". With that change, rate() over the monotonic sum yields requests per second, matching nginx.net.request_per_s.

The quantity (request rate), unit (requests/s), the sum aggregation and the absence of grouping are otherwise correct. The $scope template variable has no prefix and default *, so dropping it is correct.
